text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Trainer, look at that!
It's getting super lively and—whoops.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...That's enough goofing around!
The actual 'Shopping District Grand Thanksgiving Festival' is tomorrow.
Today, I'm on final inspection duty—gotta do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay!
We won—!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, here you two are!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Win at Rock-Paper-Scissors, get one!
Find the winning stick after eating, get one!
Care to test your luck with a chocolate banana~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"People gather where there's fun," as a certain
someone once told me.
Thanks to that, business is booming~

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see! Ehehe, we were drawn over
by all the fun voices too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, then let me test my luck!
I'm gonna win a ton of stuff~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*~. A big haul of both victories and prizes!
I ended up pretty stuffed, didn't I?
Next, how about doing something to work off all that food—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nhihi, welcome, welcome~!
I've been waiting for you~!
It's gotten waaaay scarier now~~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A haunted house...! I-I see.
However, I tried it before!
There is no reason to be that afraid...

"I waaant... faaast... feeeet...
Hehehe."
Y O U R   L E G S.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Run, run!
Trainer, run away—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grab, hoist!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... *pant*...
I-I somehow made it out... in one piece...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "B-Because... before I knew it, I just picked them up! Pulling them by the hand wouldn't have made it in time..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! I'm so sorry!
Carrying you like a sack of rice, Trainer...
Ahaha, ah—...ahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, time flew by as I toured the festival with Kitasan Black—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew, festivals really
are the best, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Full bellies and full of smiles!
Shouting at the top of our lungs while playing!
Because everyone can get hyped and have fun together...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Because... I can... have fun...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What should we do!?
We're totally having fun right now!
Even though we're the final inspectors...!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: No, that's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, everyone ready? One, two...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
The “Operation Entertain Kita-chan”
is a huge success~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, a plan!? Hospitality... Whaaat!?
Then what was the final checker thing about—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, if we just invited Kita-chan and the others, they'd probably offer to help out again 'to repay the favor'.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we decided it'd be better
to have a role, even if only temporary.
choice_data_list: It seems they were being considerate of you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, you got me.
What should I even say... umm.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm so... sooo happy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's feelings, and how fun the festival
we all worked so hard on was... Every single bit of it...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was fun, wasn't it!
I feel like there were some tough times too...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's feelings, and how fun the festival
we all worked so hard on was... Every single bit of it...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was fun, wasn't it!
I feel like there were some tough times too...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
My, look at you two answering in perfect unison.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: Whoa... I'm really no match for that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um... that's right!
We're completely in sync and get along great!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're gonna brag about your sweetheart right there?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Because it's the truth!
And it seems like you feel the same way too, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Of course, I feel the exact same way!
Of course, I feel the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: Alright, you two best buds, keep showing us what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We'll work hard together as great friends!
Please keep supporting us!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thank you so much!
Hearing that makes me so happy. But—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "A festival isn't something you can make happen on your own."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A festival only happens when people respond
and resonate with the call to come together.
...Watching my father's back, that's what I learned.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So――this fun feeling is all thanks
to everyone putting their strengths together!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Heheh, that's our Kita-san!
You always know how to touch my heart!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Save your tears until tomorrow's a success!
Let's all make it a success together!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: Oooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gathered there thrust their fists into the air.
It was a thrilling moment, caught up in the united passion of the festival's eve...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gasp!! Th-That's...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You mean the haunted house, right?
Their reactions were sooo, so good!
choice_data_list: It was over in a flash from the entrance to the exit.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
Looks like we set a new record time for escaping~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Umm... excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll get my revenge at another
haunted house next time, just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Would you please stay with me
until I've overcome this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sincere attitude brought warm laughter from those around her.
I felt like I had discovered yet another reason
why she is so beloved.
